title: CrmPersistSegmentInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — chain-authored config and DAG-forwarded inputs are both legal sources, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

filters.description: The draft filter set (ADR 0265 CDP-C). Read from `ctx.inputs.filters` only.

segmentId.description: Explicit `seg:`-prefixed id (ADR 0162). Omitted, the node derives `seg:${runId}:${nodeId}` — a PER-RUN dedupe key (a retried node converges), not a cross-run fork guard; the `side-effect` classification is the guard.
